problem: Calculate the circulation $Γ$ of the vector field $F(x,y)=\frac{5}{y}\,i+\frac{1}{x}\,j$ along the ellipse $C$ with equation $25{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}=25$ oriented counterclockwise. Interpret circulation as the sum of four convergent improper line integrals over the open quadrant arcs, with independent one-sided limits at $(\pm1,0)$ and $(0,\pm5)$. The field is undefined at those four points, so the original ordinary circulation is not defined.
